anchors.paper_title: MNE-BIDS: Organizing electrophysiological data into the BIDS format and facilitating their analysis
anchors.paper_venue: The Journal of Open Source Software
anchors.reason: MNE-BIDS is a software tool for organizing electrophysiological data into BIDS, used to format the dataset, not a paper describing the PEERS data.

anchors.paper_title: EEG-BIDS, an extension to the brain imaging data structure for electroencephalography
anchors.reason: EEG-BIDS is a specification/extension of BIDS for EEG data, a standard used to organize this dataset, not a paper describing the PEERS data.

metadata.methods_description: EEG was recorded with either a 129-channel Geodesic Sensor Net (GSN 200 or HydroCel GSN) using Netstation (EGI), or a 128-channel BioSemi headcap using the BioSemi ActiveTwo system. Subject-specific electrode layouts were not recorded; the CapTrak coordinates reflect a generic layout for each headcap.
